prompts.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent game sprite atlas for a painterly 2D desert artillery game, warm orange sandstone, dusty olive vegetation, sunlight upper left, detailed brushwork matching a hand-painted American southwest mesa illustration. Four separate objects arranged in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid with generous transparent margins and no overlap: top left a low wide sagebrush desert shrub with branches ending together at a small root at ground level; top right a low cluster of rust-red sandstone rocks; bottom left a small ochre adobe house with flat roof, exposed timber roof ends, dark doorway and small window; bottom right an old dusty tan pickup truck viewed side on. All viewed from the side with only a little top surface visible. Each object sits on the same level within its grid cell. Entire silhouettes visible. NO ground, NO soil mound, NO pedestal, NO foundation slab, NO horizon, NO lettering. Real transparent background.
prompts.strata: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque 2D game terrain material atlas. Paint a wide rectangular sandstone cross section texture, straight on, edge to edge with NO sky, NO silhouettes, NO objects, NO text, NO borders. Four equally tall horizontal zones stacked from top to bottom, each occupying exactly one quarter of the image: first fine golden desert sand with subtle horizontal wind ripples and tiny scattered grains; second orange mesa cliff rock with broad weathered ledges and angular joints; third alternating thin undulating golden yellow and red sedimentary sandstone beds with fine cracks; fourth darker rust-red massive fractured bedrock with large irregular angular slabs and deep seams. Warm hand-painted desert concept art with crisp readable forms, sunlight from upper left, ochre highlights and reddish brown shadows. Each zone continuous across entire width and suitable for horizontal repetition. Detailed painted illustration, not photorealism. Wide landscape aspect.
